title: I made an OSRS/Melvor style idle MMO that runs in your browser, built with Claude Opus and Three.js. Free alpha is open
author: Slapbox98
selftext:
Evertrail Idle is an idle RPG where your adventurer keeps working while you're away. Chop, mine, fish, fight, craft, and come back to your progress (up to 24h).



What's in it right now:

\- 17 skills, from woodcutting and fishing to thieving, farming and herblore

\- a full 3D world where you see other players working right next to you

\- idle combat with melee, ranged and magic, plus the Trials, an endless ladder with rare loot

\- Exploration, a skill where you hire a scout and chart the map

\- clans with a shared clan boss

\- a player market and leaderboards



Built with Claude Opus doing the code, Three.js for the 3D, ChatGPT and Tripo for the art and models.



It's free, runs in the browser and you can play as a guest without an account:

[https://evertrailidle.com/](https://evertrailidle.com/)



It's an alpha so stuff will break, feedback is very welcome!
